mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtered fluid into the recovery tube was most worthwhile: it showed why the body takes useful substances and water back rather than just filtering out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder felt fairly predictable compared with following the fluid.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets useful glucose and water through along with waste.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave the connections a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue: tracing filtering and recovery was interesting, although the organ-fitting steps were straightforward.
